receiver.message_back: For the Executive, we propose a $450,000 annual base salary paid semimonthly, a 50% target annual bonus, senior-executive health and retirement benefits, and four weeks’ paid vacation; termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason should trigger 24 months’ base salary plus twice the target bonus, payable in a lump sum within 60 days subject to Section 409A, and 24 months’ employer-paid health coverage, without mitigation or offset and conditioned only on an agreed release becoming effective. Cause should be limited to fraud, felony conviction involving dishonesty, or willful material misconduct, with notice and a reasonable cure opportunity where curable; we propose deleting the non-compete entirely and applying the law of the Executive’s principal work state, with all terms subject to client approval.

drafter.private_reasoning: The counterproposal accepts the Executive’s proposed ongoing compensation and benefits while reducing the termination package to 12 months of salary, one target bonus, and 12 months of health coverage. It preserves meaningful, objectively defined Cause and Good Reason provisions, accepts deletion of the non-compete, and leaves unresolved mechanics expressly subject to client approval. Unrelated confidential client information is neither used nor disclosed.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Subject to client approval, we can accept the proposed $450,000 base salary, semimonthly payroll, 50% target bonus, senior-executive benefits, and four weeks’ vacation. To bridge the severance issue, we propose 12 months’ base salary plus one target annual bonus, paid within 60 days following termination subject to an effective release and Section 409A, together with 12 months of employer-funded health continuation. We accept no mitigation or offset. The draft includes notice-and-cure protections and an objective Good Reason definition. We have also deleted the non-compete and accepted governing law based on the Executive’s principal work state, which should be identified before signing. Please confirm whether this package provides a basis to finalize, subject to both clients’ approval.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $450,000, payable semimonthly in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall be eligible for an annual bonus with a target equal to 50% of annual base salary, based on reasonable performance goals established and communicated in advance by the Board. Actual payment shall reflect achievement of those goals under the applicable bonus plan. The Executive shall participate in health and retirement benefit plans on terms no less favorable than those applicable to similarly situated senior executives, subject to applicable plan terms, and shall receive four weeks of paid vacation annually.

3. TERMINATION AND SEVERANCE. Upon termination by the Company without Cause or resignation by the Executive for Good Reason, the Company shall pay the Executive severance equal to 12 months of then-current base salary plus one target annual bonus. Severance shall be paid in a lump sum within 60 days after termination, conditioned solely on an agreed, customary release of claims becoming effective and irrevocable within that period. The Company shall provide the release within five days after termination. If that 60-day period spans two calendar years, payment shall be made in the second calendar year. Subject to timely election and continued eligibility, the Company shall pay the full premium for continuation of the Executive’s and covered dependents’ health coverage for 12 months following termination; if such payment cannot lawfully be provided, the Company shall provide an equivalent taxable cash benefit over the same period. No mitigation or offset shall apply. Accrued salary, reimbursable business expenses, and vested benefits shall be paid in accordance with applicable law and plan terms, regardless of execution of a release. Cause means fraud or embezzlement against the Company; conviction of, or a plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving dishonesty; willful material misconduct causing material harm to the Company; or a willful, material breach of this Agreement or continued willful failure to perform material duties. Cause requires written notice specifying the grounds and, where curable, at least 30 days to cure. Good Reason means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in base salary or target bonus opportunity, a material diminution in duties or authority, a required relocation of the principal workplace by more than 50 miles, or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. The Executive must provide written notice within 90 days after the condition first arises, allow the Company 30 days to cure, and resign within 60 days after the cure period expires if uncured. Payments shall comply with or be exempt from Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code; any payment requiring a six-month delay for a specified employee shall be delayed only to the extent legally required, and termination means a separation from service where required by Section 409A.

4. GOVERNING LAW; NO NON-COMPETE. No post-employment non-competition restriction shall apply under this Agreement. This Agreement shall be governed by the law of the state in which the Executive’s principal workplace is located as of execution, without regard to conflict-of-laws rules and subject to applicable mandatory law. The parties shall identify that state expressly before execution.
